comparison.objective: Free a bottle jammed in a capper infeed starwheel, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained jam diagnosis and force-limited bottle extraction versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine collar rotation, relocking, and repeated impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Jam clearance without bottle or machine damage is title-implied; no body/specs or force/damage thresholds are supplied. Candidate validates stroke, hard-stop avoidance, rebound, overload, and drift.
comparison.reason: Jam recovery tests safe extraction from constrained machinery, not adjustment of energy absorption.
